theorem prime_pair_119_characterization :

    (p * q - (p + q) = 119 ↔ (p = 11 ∧ q = 13) ∨ (p = 13 ∧ q = 11)) := by
  intro p q hp hq hp4 hp18 hq4 hq18 hne
  interval_cases p <;> interval_cases q <;> revert hp hq hne <;> decide

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem prime_pair_119_characterization :
  ∀ p q : ℕ,
    Nat.Prime p → Nat.Prime q → 4 ≤ p → p ≤ 18 → 4 ≤ q → q ≤ 18 → p ≠ q →
    (p * q - (p + q) = 119 ↔ (p = 11 ∧ q = 13) ∨ (p = 13 ∧ q = 11)) := by
  intro p q hp hq hp4 hp18 hq4 hq18 hne
  have hp_range : p ∈ Finset.Icc 4 18 := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hp4, hp18⟩
  have hq_range : q ∈ Finset.Icc 4 18 := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hq4, hq18⟩
  have hp_prime : p ∈ ((Finset.Icc 4 18).filter Nat.Prime) := by
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    exact ⟨hp_range, hp⟩
  have hq_prime : q ∈ ((Finset.Icc 4 18).filter Nat.Prime) := by
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    exact ⟨hq_range, hq⟩
  let primes := (Finset.Icc 4 18).filter Nat.Prime
  have h_all : ∀ a ∈ primes, ∀ b ∈ primes, a ≠ b → (a * b - (a + b) = 119 ↔ (a = 11 ∧ b = 13) ∨ (a = 13 ∧ b = 11)) := by
    decide
  exact h_all p hp_prime q hq_prime hne
